b:ema.d: A single exponential moving average line on the price chart, 20 bars on the close by default, weighted toward recent bars.

b:lsma.d: Least squares moving average: the end point of a straight-line fit over the last 25 bars, colored by its slope.

b:moving-average.d: One or two moving averages in one study, with 13 types to choose from, including SMA, EMA, HMA, ALMA, KAMA and VWMA.

b:ma-envelope.d: A moving average with upper and lower bands set a fixed percent away, 2.5% around a 20-bar SMA by default.

b:sma.d: A single simple moving average line on the price chart: the plain average of the last 20 closes by default.

b:rma.d: Smoothed (Wilder) moving average, 14 bars by default, a slow and steady line colored by its slope.

b:vidya.d: VIDYA: an adaptive moving average that speeds up in strong moves and slows in quiet ones, colored by trend regime.

b:williams-alligator.d: Williams Alligator: three smoothed averages of median price, shifted forward, called the jaw, teeth and lips.

b:zlema.d: Zero-lag EMA: an exponential average with a de-lag step, 21 bars by default, colored by slope.

b:awesome-oscillator.d: Awesome Oscillator histogram: 5-bar minus 34-bar simple average of median price, green when rising and red when falling.

b:balance-of-power.d: Balance of Power: where each candle closed relative to its open, scaled by its range, from -1 to +1.

b:chande-momentum-oscillator.d: Chande Momentum Oscillator: net up moves versus down moves over 9 bars, from -100 to +100, with levels at plus and minus 50.

b:commodity-channel-index.d: Commodity Channel Index: how far typical price sits from its 20-bar average, in units of mean deviation, with plus and minus 100 levels.

b:connors-rsi.d: Connors RSI: average of a 3-bar RSI, a streak RSI and a 100-bar percent rank of returns, with levels at 90 and 10.

b:coppock-curve.d: Coppock Curve: a 10-bar weighted average of the sum of a 14-bar and an 11-bar rate of change, around zero.

b:detrended-price-oscillator.d: Detrended Price Oscillator: price minus a shifted 21-bar average, to show short cycles without the trend.

b:elder-ray.d: Elder Ray: Bull Power (high minus 13 EMA) and Bear Power (low minus 13 EMA) as two histograms.

b:fisher-transform.d: Fisher Transform: median price turned into a sharp oscillator over 9 bars, with a one-bar trigger line.

b:gator-oscillator.d: Gator Oscillator: two histograms showing how far the Alligator's jaw, teeth and lips are spreading or converging.

b:know-sure-thing.d: Know Sure Thing: a weighted blend of four smoothed rates of change, with a 9-bar signal line.

b:linear-regression-slope.d: Linear regression slope: the slope of a straight-line fit over the last 100 bars, green when rising and red when falling.

b:macd.d: MACD: the 12 EMA minus the 26 EMA, a 9-bar signal line and a histogram showing the gap between the two lines.

b:ppo.d: Percentage Price Oscillator: the gap between a 12 and 26 EMA as a percent of the slow EMA, with signal line and histogram.

b:rate-of-change.d: Rate of Change: percent change from 9 bars ago, or the raw difference in Momentum mode, around a zero line.

b:rsi.d: Relative Strength Index: Wilder RSI over 14 bars from 0 to 100, with overbought at 70 and oversold at 30.

b:relative-vigor-index.d: Relative Vigor Index: the close-minus-open move compared with the bar range over 10 bars, with a signal line.

b:schaff-trend-cycle.d: Schaff Trend Cycle: a MACD run through two stochastic passes, from 0 to 100, with triggers at 75 and 25.

b:smi-ergodic.d: SMI Ergodic: double-smoothed price momentum (20 and 5 EMAs) with a 5-bar signal line, or as a histogram.

b:stochastic.d: Stochastic oscillator: where the close sits in its 14-bar range, smoothed %K and %D, with levels at 80 and 20.

b:stochastic-rsi.d: Stochastic RSI: a stochastic of the 14-bar RSI, with smoothed %K and %D lines and levels at 80 and 20.

b:stk_msess.d: Draws one past session's prior-day levels, open, gap, opening range and initial balance, with a marker where the outcome happened.

b:trix.d: TRIX: the one-bar percent change of a triple-smoothed 18-bar EMA, plotted with a 9-bar signal line.

b:true-strength-index.d: True Strength Index: double-smoothed price momentum (25 and 13 EMAs) with a 13-bar signal line.

b:ultimate-oscillator.d: Ultimate Oscillator: buying pressure over 7, 14 and 28 bars blended 4:2:1, from 0 to 100, with levels at 70 and 30.

b:williams-percent-r.d: Williams %R: where the close sits in its 14-bar high-low range, from 0 to -100, with levels at -20 and -80.

b:average-true-range.d: Average True Range: the 14-bar Wilder average of each bar's true range, a plain measure of how much price moves.

b:bollinger-bands.d: Bollinger Bands: a 20-bar SMA with bands two standard deviations above and below, filled between them.

b:percent-b.d: Bollinger %B: where price sits relative to 20-bar, 2-deviation Bollinger Bands; 1 is the upper band, 0 the lower.

b:bandwidth.d: Bollinger BandWidth: the gap between the bands as a share of the middle line, with squeeze and bulge levels over 125 bars.

b:chaikin-volatility.d: Chaikin Volatility: percent change of the 10-bar EMA of high minus low, compared with 10 bars earlier.

b:chandelier-exit.d: Chandelier Exit: trailing stop lines set three ATRs from the 22-bar highest high and lowest low.

b:choppiness-index.d: Choppiness Index: how much price wandered versus how far it went over 14 bars, from 0 to 100, with bands at 61.8 and 38.2.

b:donchian-channels.d: Donchian Channels: the highest high and lowest low of the last 20 bars, with a middle line between them.

b:historical-volatility.d: Historical volatility: the standard deviation of 10-bar log returns, scaled to a yearly figure with 252 periods by default.

b:keltner-channels.d: Keltner Channels: a 20-bar EMA of the close with bands set two times the 10-bar ATR above and below it.

b:mass-index.d: Mass Index: a 25-bar sum of the ratio of single to double 9-bar EMAs of the range, with setup 27 and trigger 26.5.

b:relative-volatility-index.d: Relative Volatility Index: an RSI-style line built from 10-bar standard deviation on up and down closes, levels at 80 and 20.

b:standard-deviation.d: Standard deviation of the close over 20 bars, a simple measure of how widely price is spread around its average.

b:ttm-squeeze.d: TTM Squeeze: momentum histogram with dots that show when Bollinger Bands sit inside Keltner Channels.

b:ulcer-index.d: Ulcer Index: the root-mean-square of percent drawdowns from the 14-bar high, with a stress level at 5.

b:volume.d: Volume bars at the bottom of the price chart, green on up candles and red on down candles.

b:vpvr.d: Volume profile for the visible chart: horizontal volume rows by price, with a point of control and a 70% value area.

b:stk_svp.d: Draws a volume profile for each session on the chart, with the point of control and the 70% value area high and low lines.

b:stk_pdvp.d: Draws the prior session's point of control as a solid line and its value area high and low as dashed lines on today's chart.

b:stk_avwap.d: Plots a volume-weighted average price from a chosen bar, with bands one, two and three standard deviations above and below.

b:vwap.d: VWAP: the volume weighted average of typical price, reset each session, with optional deviation bands.

b:stk_rvol.d: Shows each bar's volume as a multiple of the average volume at the same time of day, as a histogram with high bars highlighted.

b:stk_vheatmap.d: Shades horizontal bands behind price where the most volume traded in the visible range, coloured by candle direction.

b:stk_patterns.d: Finds classic chart patterns from swing pivots and draws them with outline lines, names and a neckline or breakout line.

p:avwap-click.d: Lets you click any candle to start an Anchored VWAP from that bar, with standard-deviation bands, in one step from the picker.

b:accumulation-distribution.d: Accumulation/Distribution line: a running total of volume weighted by where each bar closes in its range.

b:chaikin-money-flow.d: Chaikin Money Flow: 20-bar money flow volume divided by 20-bar volume, around a zero line.

b:chaikin-oscillator.d: Chaikin Oscillator: the 3-bar EMA minus the 10-bar EMA of the Accumulation/Distribution line, around zero.

b:ease-of-movement.d: Ease of Movement: how far price moved per unit of volume, smoothed with a 14-bar SMA, around zero.

b:force-index.d: Force Index: the bar's price change times its volume, smoothed with a 13-bar EMA, around a zero line.

b:intraday-intensity.d: Intraday Intensity: volume weighted by where each bar closes in its range, as a 21-bar oscillator or a running line.

b:klinger-oscillator.d: Klinger Oscillator: the 34-bar EMA minus the 55-bar EMA of volume force, with a 13-bar signal line.

b:money-flow-index.d: Money Flow Index: a volume-weighted RSI of typical price over 14 bars, with levels at 80 and 20.

b:negative-volume-index.d: Negative Volume Index: a running line that moves only on bars with lower volume than the bar before, with a 255-bar EMA.

b:on-balance-volume.d: On Balance Volume: a running total that adds volume on up closes and subtracts it on down closes.

b:pvo.d: Percentage Volume Oscillator: the gap between a 12 and 26-bar EMA of volume as a percent, with signal and histogram.

b:positive-volume-index.d: Positive Volume Index: a running line that moves only on bars with higher volume than the bar before, with a 255-bar EMA.

b:price-volume-trend.d: Price Volume Trend: a running total of volume times the percent change in close, with an optional signal line.

b:volume-flow-indicator.d: Volume Flow Indicator: signed volume over 130 bars with a volatility cutoff and volume cap, plus a signal line.

b:volume-oscillator.d: Volume Oscillator: the percent gap between a 5 and 10-bar EMA of volume, around a zero line.
